controls: Increment 412 display must use globally unique contiguous operation numbers 10369-11376 and retain an explicit repair receipt.
Starter manifest must bind slot task attempt continuation target rows and declared candidate count before vector scanning.
Business mode must consume the exact current authority GML allowlist rather than recursively discovering unrelated vector formats.
Every selected vector must resolve inside the current run authority root without symlink or reparse-point escape.
Layer count and per-layer feature count require explicit bounds and receipts before full iteration.
Selected polygon coordinates must be finite two-dimensional EPSG:27700 values with unsupported Z or M semantics blocked.
Original and accepted polygon areas must be positive plausible and compared before any geometry repair or transform.
Persist both source geometry bytes/hash and a deterministic normalized EPSG:27700 geometry hash.
Source CRS must explicitly resolve to the expected authority/code; empty or locally inferred CRS must block.
Re-read current GML bytes after matching and require start/end SHA equality to detect mid-run mutation.
EA sampler input must bind task attempt continuation exact row/parcel/HMLR identities and normalized polygon hashes.
GetCapabilities must return bounded XML with the WCS capabilities root, approved final host and a recorded digest.
DescribeCoverage root, exact CoverageId, grid envelope and advertised axes must agree before subsets are built.
Resolved request must contain one service/version/request/coverage/format/CRS pair and exactly two correctly ordered subset parameters.
Content-Length when present must equal streamed bytes and the sampled bytes must retain one stable SHA-256.
Width height band count and total decoded pixels require strict bounds before raster allocation and masking.
Dataset mask band mask declared NoData and sentinel filtering must agree; contradictory validity must block.
Independently enumerated valid pixel centres inside the polygon must equal the masked-array valid count.
Recorded min/max pixel centres must satisfy the exact polygon membership rule and bind row column coordinates and GeoTIFF SHA.
Each target row requires a request/response receipt with timestamps URL geometry hash byte count and SHA in stage order.
Exactly three unique rows must jointly bind canonical parcel IDs HMLR IDs coverage ID and distinct current GeoTIFF hashes.
The six ASCII header keys must use strict grammar and duplicate or unknown conflicting keys must block.
Numeric body must contain exactly 200 data rows and exactly 200 tokens in every row.
NODATA_value must be finite parseable and distinguishable from legitimate sampled heights.
Selected ASC bytes must have equal start/end SHA around parsing and sampling.
Tile identity derived from xllcorner/yllcorner must equal archive container member basename GML metadata and required tile.
A pixel centre or all-touched cell intersecting adjacent tiles must be assigned once with duplicate coordinates blocked.
Every sampled row/column must round-trip through the 50m affine transform to the expected British National Grid centre.
Per-tile flying/acquisition date must parse deterministically be non-future and not post-date the product release receipt.
GEMINI metadata must identify OS Terrain 50 and grid spatial representation rather than contours or another product.
Each required tile must have exactly one numeric ASC one GML one PRJ and one Metadata_<tile>.xml; auxiliary style XML is diagnostic only.
Manifest candidate operation source and example responses must be valid UTF-8 JSON with approved media type/charset and no invalid surrogate text.
operation_no must be a canonical positive JSON integer; booleans floats numeric strings and overflow values must block.
Every operation row must use accepted status/stage values and a non-empty bounded details summary.
A business measurement example may satisfy exactly one target row and must not claim one value for several target_rows.
Each visible target requires explicit current HMLR geometry EA primary metric and OS Terrain50 secondary-crosscheck source roles.
The bounded git wrapper must execute the exact resolved git binary instead of probing git then hard-coding git.exe.
Dirty recovery must bind the created stash OID/message to the current run and reject concurrent refs/stash movement.
Finding one transient or legacy process but no persistent daemon must produce a blocked non-zero helper exit rather than success.
A process matching the daemon command line may pass only with a fresh slot heartbeat/claim; stale presence must block or enter guarded restart.
